articles.title: Stacking the odds: A blueprint for successfully scaling agentic AI
articles.summary: Many enterprises are scaling AI agents faster than they are redesigning the work underneath. A detailed blueprint supports the rollout and lays the groundwork for lasting value creation.

articles.title: Australia’s next century of plenty
articles.summary: Australia’s prosperity has been built through deliberate choices, investment, and reinvention. After a lost decade of growth, the nation can draw on its strengths to choose another century of plenty.

articles.title: The future of US manufacturing
articles.summary: A quarter of America’s manufactured imports face critical trade dependencies. Strengthening US manufacturing will depend not only on capital but also on talent, energy, and resilient supplier networks.

articles.title: Capturing life cycle value in Europe’s trucking industry
articles.summary: The vast majority of Europe’s truck-related revenue flows after a vehicle is sold. Capturing that value presents a major growth opportunity.

articles.title: Strategy in the age of arenas
articles.summary: A group of fast-growing industries is reshaping the competitive landscape. Their rise requires business leaders to rethink strategy in two important ways.
